findings.description: container stdout 使用 communicate，无界主机内存；pool 无 idle 时无限创建容器

findings.description: 新增功能误放在 0.11 packaging note，并称 First published；Quickstart 误援旧 wheel 验证

findings.description: Owner could call advance on a terminal run without execute permission
findings.fix: Worker inspection requires execute even for terminal returns

findings.description: Missing or foreign hosted approval caused TypeError instead of uniform denial
findings.fix: Deny unavailable run before record conversion

findings.description: Revoked owner without grant could remain waiting; suspended organization blocked settlement
findings.fix: Stop waiting on revoked/cancelled/expired owner and permit worker-only reconciliation reads

findings.description: Checkpoint projection validation summed usage without rechecking complete result/receipt semantics
findings.fix: Revalidate typed result, receipt, kind, usage, units, digest and logical denial facts

findings.description: Budget rejection could persist staged admission or approval-consumption intents as facts
findings.fix: Restore committed checkpoint/trace before budget-exhausted terminal save

findings.description: Settled actual scalar overspend caused a repeated success-save conflict and no terminal convergence
findings.fix: Classify actual success budget violation as CloudBudgetExceeded and retain costs in EXHAUSTED

findings.description: Model HTTP response buffering and per-read deadlines allowed unbounded body or slow response lifetime
findings.fix: Bound raw identity response bytes before parsing and enforce whole-request timeout; retain unknown usage

findings.description: Release staging could write through substituted output links or read unbounded/nonregular artifacts
findings.fix: Descriptor-relative no-follow bounded regular reads, private complete staging, exclusive writes and rollback

findings.description: Concurrent identical spill replacements could unlink a safely opened inode and trigger a false corruption error
findings.fix: Allow zero-link open inode with digest verification; still reject multiple links

findings.description: Lease could expire during expensive result canonicalization before the final checkpoint update
findings.fix: Serialize before the final lease recheck and reject expiry with full transaction rollback

findings.description: Repository map imported backend internals instead of the public SDK contract
findings.fix: Add public safe file iterator and consume it through SDK facade; do not relax architecture allowlist

findings.description: Explicit sdist membership test omitted the audited hosted consumer example
findings.fix: Add exactly cloud_hosted_demo.py to expected public sdist inputs
